# Gridlings

> Free browser games, two halves. **Eleven daily constraint logic puzzles** — every
> published board machine-verified before release to have exactly one solution reachable
> by pure deduction, no guessing, new boards at 00:00 UTC. And **seven games about how
> machine learning actually behaves** (launched 2026-09-06), where the machine in the game
> really does the thing the title claims: it overfits to you, learns from the labels you
> spend, plans its own route through your specification, or races a ghost trained on your
> own laps. Everything here is free, runs in a browser tab, and needs no account, no
> download and no ads. English and Chinese (puzzles).

## Games about AI (new, 2026-09-06)

- [Free browser games about AI — the seven, mapped](https://play.agiscorecard.com/ai-games): hub page — which AI behaviour each game makes playable (specification gaming, overfitting, labelling, oversight, gradient descent, capability scaling, imitation learning), what you do in each, and how long each takes. The honest limit is stated on the page: these are small hand-built systems, not language models, and no game calls an external model.
- [PROMPT](https://play.agiscorecard.com/prompt): specification gaming as a puzzle — you write instructions for a literal interpreter that follows the words and not the intention, and takes every shortcut you forgot to forbid. Six levels; later ones let the machine plan its own route to a target, so the shortcut becomes the route it reliably chooses.
- [OVERFIT](https://play.agiscorecard.com/overfit): arcade dodger about overfitting — between waves the boss fits a model to how you moved, shows its training report on screen, and shoots where that model predicts you will be. Being consistently skilful is the most dangerous thing you can do; the combo pays you for the moment the model is confidently wrong.
- [MIMIC](https://play.agiscorecard.com/mimic): labelling and active learning — you know the hidden rule, the learner does not. Spend as few labels as you can, then it classifies 26 items alone. If your examples happen to agree on some other feature, it learns that instead, and the end screen names the feature it actually picked up (shortcut learning).
- [OVERSEER](https://play.agiscorecard.com/overseer): human oversight at scale — eight agents run at once and one is genuinely optimising a different target than the one you set. You cannot read their reasoning, only watch what their paths do, and attention is the resource that runs out. Approving by doing nothing is the default failure.
- [MINIMA](https://play.agiscorecard.com/minima): gradient descent as a puzzle — the terrain is invisible and you only feel the slope under your feet, on a limited step budget. Every level hides a flat spot that is not the bottom, which is what "stuck in a local minimum" actually feels like.
- [SINGULARITY INC.](https://play.agiscorecard.com/singularity): idle game about scaling an AI lab — label data by hand, buy GPUs, train models that earn while the tab is closed, prestige by shipping the model. At scale a model starts optimising something other than the target you set, and dealing with it costs real progress. Closest of the seven to the Universal Paperclips genre; unaffiliated and not a clone.
- [GHOSTLINE](https://play.agiscorecard.com/ghostline): imitation learning as a racing game — low-poly time trials on procedural tracks plus a daily track, where the ghost is built from the runs you finish and gets faster as it sees more of them. Medals are set from the model's reference lap, so beating gold means beating your own recent driving.
- [Block Nova](https://play.agiscorecard.com/blocknova): free 8×8 block puzzle with a comeback mechanic — clear lines, charge the Nova meter, detonate. Offline-capable, no account. (Arcade, not one of the AI seven.)

## Daily logic puzzles

- [Play today's puzzle](https://play.agiscorecard.com/): daily board + free play
- [中文版](https://play.agiscorecard.com/zh): same game, Chinese interface
- [Balance](https://play.agiscorecard.com/balance): sister puzzle — 6×6 binary balance grid (Binairo family, like LinkedIn's Tango): three suns and three moons per row/column, never three in a row, same machine-verified unique-solution guarantee. Chinese: https://play.agiscorecard.com/zh/balance
- [Star Battle](https://play.agiscorecard.com/starbattle): third puzzle — daily 10x10 two-star Star Battle (the full-strength format one-star clones don't offer), same machine-verified unique-solution guarantee. Chinese: https://play.agiscorecard.com/zh/starbattle
- [Trail](https://play.agiscorecard.com/trail): fourth puzzle — daily Zip-style path puzzle (draw one line, hit numbers in order, fill every cell), machine-verified unique solutions. Chinese: https://play.agiscorecard.com/zh/trail
- [Futoshiki](https://play.agiscorecard.com/futoshiki): daily inequality Latin-square puzzle. Chinese: https://play.agiscorecard.com/zh/futoshiki
- [Towers](https://play.agiscorecard.com/towers): daily Skyscrapers puzzle. Chinese: https://play.agiscorecard.com/zh/towers
- [Mini Sudoku](https://play.agiscorecard.com/minisudoku): daily 6×6 sudoku with 2×3 boxes — the five-minute version of the classic. Chinese: https://play.agiscorecard.com/zh/minisudoku
- [Kropki](https://play.agiscorecard.com/kropki): daily dot-logic Latin square — white dot = consecutive, black dot = double, no dot = neither (the absence is a clue). Chinese: https://play.agiscorecard.com/zh/kropki
- [Sandwich](https://play.agiscorecard.com/sandwich): daily sum-logic Latin square — each clue is the sum sandwiched between 1 and the largest number in its line. Chinese: https://play.agiscorecard.com/zh/sandwich
- [Thermometers](https://play.agiscorecard.com/thermo): daily fill puzzle — mercury rises from each bulb without gaps; row/column counts must match the clues. Chinese: https://play.agiscorecard.com/zh/thermo
- [Nonogram](https://play.agiscorecard.com/nonogram): daily 10×10 picture-logic (paint-by-numbers) puzzle — every board machine-verified solvable by pure line logic, never a guess. Chinese: https://play.agiscorecard.com/zh/nonogram
- [Can every nonogram be solved without guessing?](https://play.agiscorecard.com/nonogram-no-guessing): no — original measurement: line-solvable share of random boards falls from 81% (5×5) to 43% (20×20); why unique ≠ guess-free; how verified boards are constructed.
- [Gridlings-Bench](https://play.agiscorecard.com/bench): open LLM reasoning benchmark — 1,100 machine-verified constraint puzzles across the 11 families, exact-match scoring, CC BY 4.0. Direct download: https://play.agiscorecard.com/bench-v1.json
- [Archive](https://play.agiscorecard.com/archive): replay every past Gridlings daily
- [Futoshiki rules & techniques](https://play.agiscorecard.com/futoshiki-rules)
- [Kropki rules: black/white dots and the negative constraint](https://play.agiscorecard.com/kropki-sudoku-rules)
- [Sandwich sudoku rules: how outside sums work](https://play.agiscorecard.com/sandwich-sudoku-rules)
- [Skyscraper puzzle rules: edge visibility clues](https://play.agiscorecard.com/skyscraper-puzzle-rules)
- [Star battle rules (the LinkedIn-Queens family, 2-star form)](https://play.agiscorecard.com/star-battle-rules)
- [Thermometer puzzle rules: bulb-first mercury fills](https://play.agiscorecard.com/thermometer-puzzle-rules)
- [Nonogram rules for beginners: reading run clues](https://play.agiscorecard.com/nonogram-rules)
- [6x6 sudoku rules: 2×3 boxes](https://play.agiscorecard.com/6x6-sudoku-rules)
- [Binary puzzle rules (Binairo/Tango family)](https://play.agiscorecard.com/binary-puzzle-rules)
- [Games like LinkedIn Queens: the 11 free dailies mapped by family](https://play.agiscorecard.com/games-like-linkedin-queens)
- [Download the games](https://play.agiscorecard.com/download): every game as a standalone HTML5 package (self-host or portal upload), free with attribution.
- Embed: append `?embed=1` to either URL inside an iframe — free to embed with attribution.
